meta.phaseDetail: Magic 4-7, 9th in the East. Tonight vs Milwaukee (NBA Cup), 7:00 PM.

brief.headline: Suggs upgraded to questionable as Magic host Bucks in NBA Cup tonight
brief.summary: Jalen Suggs, out the last eight games with a right knee bone bruise, was upgraded to questionable for tonight's NBA Cup game against Milwaukee and still has to clear shootaround and warmups. Jamal Cain (shoulder) and Tristan da Silva (calf) are also questionable. Orlando (4-7) moved up to 9th in the East after Charlotte lost Thursday, and goes for its first home win of the season against the 1-11 Bucks.

bullets.text: Suggs was upgraded to questionable Thursday. He has not played since hurting his right knee Oct 25 at New York, and the team said Monday he was "progressing positively" with increased court work. He needs to get through shootaround and warmups before being cleared (Orlando Sentinel, RotoWire).
Cain (left shoulder contusion) and da Silva (left calf strain) are questionable on the official injury report after both sat Wednesday at Utah. Banchero, Isaac, Penda and Nelson are out.

Milwaukee (1-11, 15th in the East) has lost eight straight by an average of 19.1 points under first-year coach Taylor Jenkins and is 0-5 on the road. Tyler Herro scored 27 in Wednesday's 123-112 home loss to the Lakers. The Bucks had no players on the overnight NBA injury report.
DraftKings has Orlando -9.5, total 223.5, moneyline -378. The line opened at ORL -9.5 (Covers). Orlando is 5-6 against the spread this season, Milwaukee 4-8.

Charlotte lost at Phoenix on Thursday, so Orlando moves up to 9th in the East, a half-game behind 8th-place Toronto (5-7) and a half-game ahead of Charlotte and Indiana (both 4-8). Boston (10-2) leads the East.

Franz Wagner has scored 30 or more in three straight games and ranks fourth in the league in fourth-quarter scoring at 7.8 points per game (Orlando Sentinel). Orlando is 0-4 at Kia Center this season.

players.name: Paolo Banchero
players.note: Team leader in points and rebounds last season. Spent the summer working out with Kevin Durant.
players.statusNote: Out Friday vs Milwaukee, which would be his 10th straight missed game. ESPN lists an estimated return of Nov. 22. Magic said about 4-6 weeks on Oct 24; Banchero said "at least a month" on Oct 25.

players.name: Franz Wagner
players.note: Missed 48 games last season with a high ankle sprain, then strained his right calf in the playoffs. Left the preseason finale with right shoulder soreness but practiced fully Oct 20 and is off the injury report. Career-high 15 assists Nov 5 at Phoenix, with 6 turnovers. Tied his career high with 38 points Nov 11 at Utah, his third straight 30-point game.

players.name: Desmond Bane
players.note: Played all 82 games last season. Missed Nov 7 at Golden State with an illness, his first missed game with Orlando. Made 7 of 11 threes for 25 points Nov 11 at Utah.

players.name: Jalen Suggs
players.note: Led the team in assists and steals. Starting point guard job is a camp storyline.
players.statusNote: Upgraded to questionable for Friday vs Milwaukee after missing eight straight games; must clear shootaround and warmups to play (RotoWire). Mild bone bruise suffered Oct 25 at New York. The team said Nov 9 he was "progressing positively" in return-to-play protocols (Orlando Sentinel).

players.contract: $10.1M. Final rookie-scale year. No extension; restricted free agent in 2027
players.name: Anthony Black
players.note: No rookie-scale extension by the Oct 19 deadline; restricted free agent in 2027. Sat out Nov 2 vs Washington to manage a right ankle sprain and returned Nov 5 at Phoenix. Left Nov 7 at Golden State with a cramp with 2:47 left in overtime and did not return, per Sweeney.

players.name: Wendell Carter Jr.
players.note: Competing with Vucevic for the starting center spot. Had 27 points and 13 rebounds on 10-of-12 shooting Nov 5 at Phoenix.

players.name: Nikola Vucevic
players.note: Back in Orlando after playing here from 2012 to 2021. Split last season between Chicago and Boston.

players.contract: $4.0M. 2027-28 team option ($6.1M) exercised Oct 21; signed through 2027-28
players.name: Tristan da Silva

players.statusNote: Questionable for Friday vs Milwaukee on the official injury report. Has missed the last two games (at Sacramento, at Utah). No timeline announced.

players.name: Goga Bitadze
players.note: Scored 23 for Georgia in an Aug 28 World Cup qualifier. Projects as the third center.

players.name: Jonathan Isaac
players.note: Waived June 27 and re-signed on a minimum deal July 1.

transactions.text: Assigned Jonathan Isaac to the Osceola Magic and recalled him the same day, presumably to practice with the affiliate (RotoWire).
Exercised 2027-28 rookie-scale team options on Tristan da Silva (about $6.1M) and Jase Richardson (about $3.3M).
Anthony Black's rookie-scale extension deadline passed with no agreement; he will be a restricted free agent in 2027.
Waived Malaki Branham, JD Davison and Kevin Knox II after the preseason finale.
Signed Kevin Knox II to an Exhibit 10 deal. Unlike the four players signed and waived Sept 22, Knox stays in training camp; roster now stands at 20.
Signed Ace Baldwin Jr., Ricky Council IV, Jarron Cumberland and Au'Diese Toney to Exhibit 10 deals and waived all four the same day to secure their G League rights for Osceola.
Signed Malaki Branham and JD Davison to Exhibit 10 camp deals.
Re-signed Jevon Carter and Jonathan Isaac (1 yr, minimum each).
